text.card: A red giant 4,025 parsecs away, 20 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.21 solar masses and 20.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,484 K at its surface.
